pool_kind.reason: content: sanitized == 0 and metal_z is empty -> era B, the ODE sampler's free generation
pool_kind.rule: read from the CSV HEADER (and, for a 'metal_z' pool, the CONTENT of its first data row), not the run name: an explicit 'pool_kind' column is authoritative; 'n_frags_raw' in the header is the trainer's free-generation path; a 'metal_z' header is decided by its content (sanitized == 1 and metal_z non-empty -> reconstruction; sanitized == 0 and metal_z empty -> generation); both markers, a missing row or disagreeing signals -> unknown
pool_kind.measurement_meaning: the sampler's free generation: the fraction of the model's own output that is ONE connected molecule -- true of BOTH free-generation writers (the trainer's own path and the 2026-10-12+ ODE path of wf_cfm_decode_dump_smiles.py)

subject.these_numbers_are: the sampler's free generation: the fraction of the model's own output that is ONE connected molecule -- true of BOTH free-generation writers (the trainer's own path and the 2026-10-12+ ODE path of wf_cfm_decode_dump_smiles.py)
subject.these_numbers_are_not: a decoder-fidelity number: this pool IS the sampler's own free-generation output

generation_side.reason: the subject pool is the trainer's free-generation output
generation_side.what_would_be_needed: a pool the shared rule classifies as a generation pool (molmetal/scripts/cfm_pool_kind.py) -- e.g. the trainer's own 'n_frags_raw' pool, or a decode-dump pool whose content shows the ODE path

design.novelty: 1 - max Tanimoto to any training molecule
design.intdiv1: MOSES: 1 - mean pairwise Tanimoto, self-pairs included
design.single_seed_caveat: One seed, one checkpoint, n=66 survivors.  This is a first measurement, not a settled number.
design.cohort_note: the subject pool is the sampler's own free-generation output

novelty_fraction_at_0.9.definition: fraction of generated molecules with max Tanimoto < 0.9

mean_novelty.definition: 1 - mean(max Tanimoto to train); stricter than the fraction

intdiv1.note: IntDiv1 is strongly n-dependent; compare with the n-matched training subsample, not with the MOSES 0.857 reference.

docking.note: 1 of 10 pockets docked before the run died; no success rate can be computed.  The precious-metal force-field gap is separate and still open (vina_status.json).

verdict_detail.note: the gate is evaluated over the sampler's own output

verdict_rule: novelty fraction >= 0.90 AND IntDiv1 >= 0.85 AND SA <= 4.5 AND docking >= 50% on >= 20 pockets; docking is BLOCKED so the overall verdict cannot be PASS
